_instructions.title: Smart Medicine Reminder - Configuration Guide
_instructions.description: This configuration file defines active medicine compartments, prescription schedules, and inventory stock.
_instructions.how_to_change_grid: Set 'grid' to 'auto' to automatically size the grid based on 'cellCount', or specify an exact matrix dimension like '1x1', '1x2', '2x2', '4x4', '8x8'.
_instructions.how_to_change_grid_or_cell_count: Change 'cellCount' to match the number of active compartments you want loaded at boot (e.g., 1 for 1x1, 2 for 1x2, 4 for 2x2, 9 for 3x3, 16 for 4x4).
_instructions.how_to_add_a_medicine: Copy the '_template_new_occupied_cell' below and paste it into the 'cells' array, then update 'cellCount'.
_instructions.how_to_add_more_schedules: Add another '{ hour: HH, minute: MM, doseQuantity: Q }' object to the 'schedules' array of that medicine (up to 8 schedules per medicine).
